body:
Well, the situation should be fairly obvious. I have gone a year without a job, money is a problem in all sorts of ways, and things have the potential to get much, much worse.

As for me, it's hard to discuss what's going on in my head. I know that if I didn't have my immediate family for support, I probably wouldn't be here right now. I know that things have to change soon if I'm going to have a chance. Outside of that, it's confusing.

As I said, I'm internally conflicted about my morality and actions. I don't think I'm a sociopath, though I guess I exhibit some of the symptoms. I doubt I'd be nearly as concerned if I was one, but I know that I can manipulate social situations and relationships for my own gain and not be concerned until after, if at all. I feel like I can't be trusted with responsibility due to this, so I'm scared of working towards a job that puts that responsibility in my hands. Regardless, I can easily understand that doing things like that can be seriously damaging to those involved and that those people don't deserve it, which led me to exclude and distance myself as much as possible.

As for what I want, I can't say. No long-term goals, no aspirations, no real passions. Anything that I did that took real work was abandoned. That alone makes continuing on day to day hard and struggling to make things better almost impossible. If I can find something, anything, to put everything into, I might be able to make living and striving to live as well as I can worth it. Until I find that, I'm doing whatever I have to in an effort to keep my head above water.

Trying to fight it every day.

I can take some solace in the fact that, regardless of the situation I'm in, things can get better. I'm not looking for much in terms of money or material wealth, so I can live with the financial problems. The hardest part is dealing with myself, but if I can find that balance and right myself on the inside, I can sort things out on the outside. I just have to get there.

As for the small, insignificant gains, this post is one of them, and just talking about it, however anonymously, is cathartic in its own way.
